name: Symphony SA160
summary: Certified two-seat trainer derived from the Glastar kit plane; modern composite skin over a steel-tube frame and a wide, strut-braced high wing.

wings: High wing braced by a strut on each side
Large slotted flaps over much of the span
engines: Single Lycoming flat-four in a smooth, rounded cowl
fuselage: Glossy fiberglass-skinned fuselage with a wide, tall cabin

tellTales: Glossy modern composite two-seater with a strut-braced high wing
Wide, tall cabin with big glazing
Fixed tricycle gear under a clean fuselage

confusedWith.howToTell: The 150/152 is a plain all-metal airframe with a boxy cabin and a thick lift strut; the SA160 has smoother, glossy fiberglass skin and a rounder fuselage.
The 172 is a larger four-seater with a tapered wing; the SA160 is a two-seater with a smoother composite fuselage.
The V1.0 is a four-seater with a rectangular wing; the SA160 is a two-seater with a sleeker fuselage.
